parts.note_add: Catalogue figure 6630A-1 (S-005 BI p.101) draws the LAMPC. relay (67660) on the relay bracket under the dash beside the C.P.U. and horn relay; this is most likely the F-03 stop light checker of S-001 p.22 (W in, G out to stop lamps, GL to the meter warning, B ground) - confirm. OEM-RECORD.md lists F-03 as Rear, which disagrees with the catalogue drawing - confirm on the car.
FA01-66-670 is no longer available new (Atkins, NLA); used units are sold by 1st-gen breakers. Per S-001 p.20 the switch also houses the headlight cleaner switch (LY-B).

The switch position sets brake pedal height (190 +5/-0 mm, S-038 T:6; procedure S-002 11-25). Mazdatrix sells H003-66-490A as the 82-88 brake light switch for cars with cruise control, which may explain the catalogue qty 2 - confirm.

Factory unit is the H6024 7 in PAR56 halogen sealed beam (0000-11-6024-HL), 3-lug base. On the 1982 diagram RY is LOW beam and RL is HIGH beam (RL feeds the high beam indicator); headlights-popups-illumination.md has these swapped.

S-001 p.20: each motor unit holds a cam limit switch with UP/DOWN diodes and a relay; the relay switches WR to the motor and grounds it (brakes) at rest, and YG lights the 3.4 W retractor indicator while it runs. The motors take their own 0.3 sq fusible link on WR.
Left lid 8871-51-621A: NLA new, Atkins has remaining NOS stock (185 USD). Lid height is set by the adjusting screw and lock nut against the stop rubber (S-002 14-18).
After replacing a hinge, redo the lid up-down adjustment; the link snaps onto the ball pivot by finger pressure, not pliers (S-002 14-17, S-045 15:2).
Sealed beam is held by the retaining ring (screws, rotate counterclockwise to remove) and aimed with the two adjusting screws (S-002 14-16, S-045 15:1).

Used 81-83 motors are sold complete with relay, cover boot and mounting bolts. After fitting, set the motor link at its lowest (automatic stop) position with the knob and slide the motor fore/aft on its bolts to adjust the lid (S-002 14-18).
Rod B 8871-51-936 is in stock at Atkins (36.95 USD); rod A 8871-51-934 is NLA (Atkins NOS, includes bushings). A printable TPU bushing for the linkage is in the CAD library.
The knob sits on the retractor motor shaft under the boot; disconnect the battery negative before turning it (S-045 15:1, S-002 14-16).
The boot is the cover taken off to reach the manual control knob (S-002 14-16).

S-001 p.20 draws the relay inside each retractor motor unit (dashed box): coil fed through the motor limit switch, contact switches WR to the motor. So one relay per motor, on the motor - confirm. The 83-85 relay FA01-51-939 (Atkins, out of stock) is a different part.

specs.item: Retractable headlight switch contacts
specs.value: Two ganged poles: UP/ON joins WG (constant feed) to R (motor UP line); OFF/normal joins RW (from light switch, hot when LIGHT is off) to RY (motor DOWN line)
specs.note: from S-001; confirm on the car

specs.item: Continuity check, retractable headlight switch (1980 4-pin): ON A(WG)-D(R); OFF B(RW)-C(RY)
specs.note: 1980 switch 8871-66-670 has 4 pins; the same WG-R / RW-RY pairs are drawn for 1982 in S-001 p.20

specs.item: Headlight cleaner switch inside the retractable headlight switch
specs.value: LY to cleaner motor E-11 (via X-12), B to ground (X-02, X-13)
specs.note: from S-001; whether a headlight cleaner is fitted on this US car is not known - confirm

specs.item: Retractor switch test: (WG) hot with switch UP, (RY) hot with switch DOWN; then (R) hot UP and (RY) hot DOWN at the output
specs.note: 1985 cluster switch; same wire colours as the 1982 switch in S-001

specs.item: Retractor motor internal circuit
specs.value: R (UP) and RY (DOWN) each enter through a diode to a cam limit switch; its common drives the relay coil to ground; relay NO contact connects WR to the motor, NC contact grounds the motor; YG taps the motor feed through a diode to the 3.4 W retractor indicator
specs.note: from S-001; confirm with the D-199 ohm check

specs.item: Retractor motor feed
specs.value: own 0.3 sq fusible link on WR (separate from the 0.3 sq WG link and the 1.25 sq main)
specs.note: from S-001; confirm

specs.item: Motor check: battery voltage on the R wire at the motor connector with light switch or retractor switch ON (UP); voltage present but no motion = motor ground or motor fault
specs.note: 1985 procedure; motor connector wires WR, YG, R, RY are the same colours as 1982 E-03/E-04

specs.item: Manual raise: disconnect battery negative, remove the cover, turn the manual control knob on the motor shaft until the headlight is fully up
specs.note: same procedure in 1985 S-002 Section 14 p.14-16

specs.item: Lid up-down adjustment with motor: knob to lowest (automatic stop) position, loosen motor mounting bolts and nuts, reconnect link, slide motor fore/aft, tighten
specs.note: 1980 S-045 p.15:3 gives the same steps

specs.item: Lid height adjustment: loosen lock nut, turn adjusting screw in or out against the stop rubber, tighten lock nut
specs.note: 1980 S-045 p.15:3 gives the same steps

specs.item: Link to hinge ball pivot: press together by finger until an audible click, not pliers; redo lid up-down adjustment after hinge replacement
specs.note: same caution in 1985 S-002 Section 14 p.14-17

specs.item: Headlight aim: two adjusting screws per lamp; tyres at pressure, car level and unladen
specs.note: same in 1985 S-002 Section 14 p.14-16

specs.item: Halogen sealed beam wattage, high/low (GS/GSL halogen)
specs.note: the lamp symbol reads 50W/40W (conventional); the note beside it gives halogen 60/50 W. LED units reported fitted - confirm what is on the car

specs.item: Low beam wire / high beam wire
specs.note: RL also feeds the high beam indicator; S-002 15-30 labels RY low and RL high too. Confirm on the car

Brake pedal height (from floor), set by screwing the stop light switch in or out
specs.note: procedure (disconnect wires, loosen lock nut, turn switch, tighten, reconnect) from 1985 S-002 Section 11 p.11-25, same 190 mm figure

specs.item: Stop light switch contact
specs.value: normally open; closes GW to W when the brake pedal is pressed
specs.note: from S-001; confirm

specs.item: Stop light switch feed
specs.value: 15 A STOP/HORN fuse (X-04), constant (works with key off)

specs.item: Stop light switch test: test light from W to ground lights with pedal pressed; if not, check GW; if GW is hot, switch faulty or misadjusted
specs.note: 1985 connector F-03(F); wire colours GW and W match 1982 F-11
